newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real fell 0.14 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real fell 0.14 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.14 percent to close at 1.0790 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank lowered of the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank depreciated the mini-band Tuesday for the second time this month, lowering it 0.14 percent to between 1.0790 and 1.0840 reais per dollar through a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set on Thursday at between 1.0775 and 1.0825 per greenback.
In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0790 reais per greenback at a buy tender.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.11 percent to end at 1.0846 per dollar, following the mini-band decline.
In the parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.1135 per dollar, traders said.
